# QRLinkSpot

> Free QR code generator and link-in-bio (LinkSpot) page for creators and small businesses. Create a branded QR + profile in 90 seconds.

QRLinkSpot lets anyone generate a custom QR code (with logo, colors, and styles) that points to a hosted link-in-bio page. Built for barbers, restaurants, freelancers, real-estate agents, and creators who want one shareable URL for all their socials, bookings, menus, and contact info.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Free branded QR + link-in-bio overview.
- [Free QR Code Generator](/qr-code): Create and download a QR code instantly.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free forever and Pro plan details.
- [Blog](/blog): Guides on QR codes and link-in-bio marketing.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy notice.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
